p93.en: Find psychological theory in behavioral examples.

p94.original: 你找到说明心理理论的那个测试了吗？此外，请在视频中找出至少一个皮亚杰的前运算阶段思维方式的例子。请解释视频中儿童的哪些行为可以用来说明你学到的这些概念。
p94.en: Did you find that test that explains the theory? In addition, please find in the video at least one example of the way Piajj was thinking at the pre-calculation stage. Please explain what children's behaviour in the video can be used to illustrate these concepts you have learned.

p95.original: 阶段还是波动 皮亚杰的理论受到的第二个批评是它将阶段视为突然的转变。较新的研究认为，两个阶段间的转变更像一个连续的变化而不是皮亚杰理论所认为的突变。心理学家罗伯特·西格勒（Robert Siegler）为认知发展提出了一个新的隐喻（Siegler，1994）。他认为，我们可以用“波动”这个概念，而不是阶段理论暗示的突变。他认为，波动隐喻（wave metaphor）更符合科学数据和我们的日常经验，二者都说明了儿童行为的可变性。例如，在一天之中，儿童就可能用好几个不同的策略来解决同一个语言问题：“I ate.”“I eated.”和“I ated.”如果儿童从一个阶段突然跃入另一个阶段，那么我们就不可能观察到这种现象。相反，西格勒认为，发展是一种重叠的波的模式，每一道波都可以被看作一种认知策略的兴起和衰落（Azar，1995）。
p95.en: The second criticism of Piage's theory is that it sees the phase as a sudden change. A more recent study suggests that the transition between the two phases is more a continuum of change than a mutation perceived by the Piajé theory. The psychologist Robert Siegler proposed a new metaphor for cognitive development (Siegler, 1994). In his view, we could use the concept of “volatility” rather than a mutation implied by the theory of the phase. In his view, the Volatility Indices (wave metaphoor) were more in line with scientific data and our daily experience, both of which illustrated the variability of children's behaviour. For example, in one day, children may use several different strategies to address the same language: “I ate.” and “I arrived.” If children suddenly leap from one stage to another, we cannot observe this phenomenon. On the contrary, Sigler believes that development is a pattern of overlapping waves, each of which can be seen as the rise and decline of a cognitive strategy (Azar, 1995).

p96.original: 文化在学习中的重要性 俄罗斯心理学家列夫·维果斯基（Lev Vygotsky，1934，1987）非常强调文化价值观和实践在儿童认知发展中的重要性，包括沟通交流在学习中的作用。维果斯基认为，认知发展实际上是通过社交活动掌握文化规则和规范的心理过程。维果斯基的研究证明，成年人和其他“专家”通过一种称为“脚手架式教育”（scaffolding）的方法，可以帮助儿童更快地发展他们的认知能力。这得到了近年来一些研究的支持（Conner & Cross，2003；Rogoff，2003）。正如木制或钢制脚手架为建筑的结构提供了支撑，认知脚手架也为构建知识体系创造了一种支撑结构。通过密切关注儿童当前的认知技能水平，父母和教师将每一堂新的课程和儿童已知的内容相联系，这样就可以为儿童量身打造适合他们的课程。维果斯基进一步指出，需要设置适宜的新挑战，稍微超出儿童当前的学习范围，但又能够使其借助少量帮助就可以达成，不能过于困难而使儿童失败。最近发展区（zone of proximal development）这一概念为父母或老师给儿童制订学习计划提供了重要指导。
p96.en: The importance of culture in learning, the Russian psychologist Lev Vygotsky, 1934, 1987, places great emphasis on the importance of cultural values and practices in the cognitive development of children, including the role of communication in learning. Vigoski believes that cognitive development is in fact a psychological process of mastering cultural rules and norms through social activities. Wigoski's research has shown that adults and other “experts” can help children to develop their cognitive abilities more quickly through an approach called scaffolding. This is supported by a number of studies in recent years (Conner & Cross, 2003; Rogoff, 2003. Just as wooden or steel scaffolds support the structure of the building, cognitive scaffolds create a supporting structure for building knowledge systems. By following closely the current level of cognitive skills of children, parents and teachers link each new curriculum and the child's known content so that children can tailor their curriculum to suit them. Wigoski further noted that new challenges need to be put in place that go slightly beyond children's current learning, but that they can be achieved with a small amount of help and that children cannot be left to fail by being too difficult. The concept of the recent development area provides important guidance for parents or teachers to develop a learning plan for children.

p99.original: 讨论影响儿童期社会发展和情绪发展的因素。
p99.en: Discussion of factors affecting social and emotional development of children.

p100.original: 我们的健康、幸福，甚至我们的生存都依赖于我们在家庭之中、与同伴之间，以及在工作上形成的有意义的、有效的关系。在孩提时期，我们开始了对所处社会所遵循的互动规则的漫长学习，包括社会的和政治的互动规则。儿童也必须学会控制自己的感受和行为，并学会理解他人的感受和行为。这个社会和情绪发展的过程是儿童期重要的发展任务之一，它既依赖于先天的遗传，也依赖于后天的环境。
p100.en: Our health, well-being and even our survival depend on the meaningful and effective relationships that we have developed within our families, with our peers, and at work. As a child, we began a long study of the rules of interaction that govern the societies in which we live, including the rules of social and political interaction. Children must also learn to control their feelings and behaviours and to understand the feelings and behaviours of others. This process of social and emotional development is one of the most important developmental tasks of childhood, and it depends on both the innate and the acquired environment.

p102.original: 儿童和世界交互的一个重要影响因素就是他们的气质（temperament）。心理学家使用气质这一术语来描述个体遗传的、“内在”的人格和行为模式。哈佛大学的杰罗姆·凯根（Jerome Kagan）研究了成千上万名儿童的气质，他观察到大约20%的儿童生来就比较害羞，而大约40%的儿童生性大胆（Kagan，1998）。害羞的婴儿在面对陌生情境时会变得不安或退缩，并且可能想要回避这样的情境。大胆的婴儿更善于交际，并可能对新环境感兴趣。
p102.en: An important factor influencing children's interaction with the world is their quality. Psychologists use the term gas to describe individual inherited, “inherent” personality and behaviour patterns. Jerome Kagan of Harvard University studied the quality of thousands of children, observing that about 20 per cent of children were born shyer, while about 40 per cent were bold (Kagan, 1998). A shy baby can become uneasy or reticent in the face of an unknown situation and may wish to avoid it. Bold babies are better able to communicate and may be interested in new environments.

p103.original: 脑成像研究表明这些差异是生理性的：和大胆的婴儿相比，害羞的婴儿的杏仁核更加活跃（Schwartz et al.，2003）。这些活跃的杏仁核会启动一系列生理上的应激反应来应对新情境，如心率变快、应激激素得到释放、皮肤温度变化加剧。因此，和大胆的、追求感官刺激的同龄人相比，害羞的儿童在生理上就对变化和压力更加敏感。然而，这种敏感性也可以成为人际关系发展的一个优势。儿童发展研究人员格拉日娜·科昌斯卡（Grazyna Kochanska，2009）提出，恐惧在儿童道德发展中扮演重要的角色，它会培养儿童对错误行为后果的意识——包括对受害者的同情。具有正常恐惧情绪的儿童，在犯错之后更有可能会感到内疚，而这种内疚感会阻止他们重复错误行为。
p103.en: The study of brain imaging shows that these differences are biological: shy babies are more active than bold babies with almonds (Schwartz et al., 2003). These active almond nuclei initiate a range of physiological stressors to respond to new situations, such as rapid heart rate, the release of hormones and increased skin temperature change. As a result, shy children are biologically more sensitive to change and stress than their bold, sensory peers. However, such sensitivity can also be an advantage in the development of human relations. Grazyna Kochanska, a researcher in child development, suggested that fear plays an important role in the moral development of children, and that it fosters children's awareness of the consequences of wrong behaviour — including compassion for victims. Children with normal fear are more likely to feel guilty after making a mistake, which prevents them from repeating wrong behaviour.

p104.original: 虽然一个人的基本气质在出生时就几乎确定了，但是它们不是一成不变的（Kagan，1996）。从很小的时候起，环境和遗传倾向就会相互作用，因此教养方式和儿童经历的其他方面可以调整气质的表达方式。通常，人们很少会和害羞的孩子互动和玩耍，这会强化孩子的先天倾向。如果父母意识到害羞宝宝的退缩，温柔地和他玩耍，鼓励他进行互动，那么这个孩子就会变得与他的预期气质不一样，会变得更加外向。同样是大胆的孩子，由大胆的父母培养的孩子和由害羞、怯懦的父母培养的孩子，对世界的反应截然不同。因此，只要儿童所处环境中的大人肯教他们，他们就有能力在自己遗传气质的范围内学到对世界的各种反应。
p104.en: Although a person's basic qualities are almost certain at birth, they are not static (Kagan, 1996). From an early age, the environment and genetic tendencies interact, so that the way in which a child is brought up and other aspects of the child's experience can be adapted to the way in which a person is expressed. Often, people rarely interact and play with shy children, which reinforces the child's birth orientation. If parents realize that the shy baby is retreating, play softly with him and encourage him to interact, the child becomes different from his expectations and more outward. Equally bold children, children raised by bold parents and children raised by shy, cowardly parents, react differently to the world. Thus, as long as children are taught by adults in their own environment, they are able to learn from the world's reactions within their genetic qualities.

p105.original: 气质通常不会随时间而改变，是非常稳定的，也就是说，你出生时的气质与你童年、青春期和成年期的气质是非常相似的。虽然环境影响可以在某种程度上调整气质，但是遗传约束限制了变化的程度。因此，重要的是要注意，没有一种气质是适宜于所有情境的。我们应该“谨记像我们这样复杂的社会，每一种气质类型都可以找到适宜自己的位置”（Kagan，quoted in Gallagher，1994，p.47）。我们大部分个体的人生成就都与我们是否能找到最大限度地发挥我们优势的环境有关。
p105.en: The quality of life, which usually does not change over time, is very stable, that is to say, you are born with very similar qualities to those of your childhood, adolescence and adulthood. While environmental impacts can adjust to some extent, genetic constraints limit the degree of change. It is therefore important to note that no quality is appropriate for all situations. We should “remember societies as complex as ours, where every gas type can find its place” (Kagan, quated in Gallagher, 1994, p.47). Most of our individual human achievements are related to whether we can find an environment that maximizes our strengths.

p107.original: 通过与父母、同伴和其他人的互动，你学会了如何与他人相处，这一发展任务被称为社会化（socialization）。然而，社会化不仅发生在儿童期。它是塑造我们的行为模式、价值、标准、技能、态度和动机以符合特定社会要求的一个毕生发展的过程（Hetherington & Parke，1975）。家庭、学校和媒体等机构给儿童施加压力，使他们接受社会认可的价值观。性别角色的社会化就是其中的一个例子：男孩和女孩经常被教导要采用不同的行为和互动方式。休闲方式的选择，如看电视或和同伴玩，这些对儿童社会化也会产生重要影响。越来越多的学龄前儿童受到他们在托儿所中经历的影响。还有一个影响因素极为重要，那就是教养方式。
p107.en: Through interaction with parents, peers and others, you have learned how to live with others, a development mission known as socialization. However, socialization does not take place only in childhood. It is a lifelong development that shapes our patterns of behaviour, values, standards, skills, attitudes and motivations to meet the requirements of a given society (Hetherington & Parke, 1975). Institutions such as the family, schools and the media put pressure on children to embrace socially accepted values. The socialization of gender roles is one example: boys and girls are often taught different ways of behaviour and interaction. The choice of leisure methods, such as watching television or playing with peers, also has important implications for the socialization of children. An increasing number of pre-school children are affected by the experiences they experience in day-care centres. Another factor of great importance is the way in which it is done.

p108.original: 四种教养方式及其影响 世界各地的家庭教养方式可以分成4种不同类型，大多数育儿方式都属于其中的一种（Baumrind，1967，1971；Russell et al.，2002）。（一旦你了解了这4种方式，你可能就会想象，如果你的父母换一种教养方式，那么你可能就会与现在不一样。）
p108.en: Four forms of upbringing, and their implications. Family upbringing can be divided into four different types, most of which belong to one of them (Baumrind, 1967, 1971); Rusell et al., 2002). (If you know these four ways, you might imagine that if your parents were to be brought up in a different way, then you might be different. I don't think so.

p109.original: 1. 专制型父母（authoritarian parent）通常都会相信一句谚语“不打不成器”。他们要求儿童守规矩、听话，不接受任何一点点对规则的讨价还价。他们会用惩罚或者威胁要进行惩罚来强迫儿童服从。
p109.en: Optimal parents (authoritarian parents) usually believe in a proverb that “do not fail”. They demand that children be disciplined and listen to each other and do not accept any little bargaining over the rules. They force children to obey with punishment or threats of punishment.

p110.original: 2. 权威型父母（authoritative parent）采用另一种教养方式，他们对儿童也采取高要求。他们对儿童有很高的期望，并且会努力达成好的结果。但是和专制型父母不同，权威型父母会将高标准和对儿童的关怀及对儿童意见的尊重相结合：他们非常愿意倾听儿童的想法和感受，也经常会在家庭中制造民主的气氛。权威型父母通常非常强调推理和解释，以此帮助儿童学会预见自己行为的结果。
p110.en: 2. Authoritative parents (authoritative parents) use alternative forms of upbringing, and they also impose high demands on children. They have high expectations for children and will strive to achieve good results. Unlike authoritarian parents, however, authoritative parents combine high standards with care for and respect for children's views: they are very willing to listen to the thoughts and feelings of children and often create a democratic atmosphere in the family. Authoritative parents often place great emphasis on reasoning and interpretation, as a way of helping children learn to anticipate the outcome of their own behaviour.

p111.original: 3. 宽容型父母（permissive parent）采用第三种教养方式。他们的规矩很少，并允许儿童自己做决定。像权威型父母一样，他们也关心孩子，乐于沟通；但是宽容型父母让孩子自己来做大多数的决定。宽容型父母相信，孩子从行为后果中学到的要比从遵从父母设定的规矩中学到的更多、更好。
p111.en: 3. A third form of upbringing is used by tolerant parents. Their rules are rare and allow children to make their own decisions. Like authoritative parents, they care about their children and are happy to communicate; However, tolerant parents leave it to the children themselves to make most decisions. Tolerance parents believe that children learn more and better from behavioural consequences than from the rules set by their parents.

p112.original: 4. 忽视型父母（uninvolved parent）倾向于漠不关心或者拒绝孩子，有时甚至到了对孩子疏于照顾和虐待的地步（Maccoby & Martin，1983）。通常，这类父母的生活充满压力，他们没有时间和精力来陪伴孩子。
p112.en: 4. Neglective parents (uninvolved parents) tend to be indifferent or rejecting children, sometimes to the point of neglect and abuse (Maccoby & Martin, 1983). Often, such parents live under stress and do not have the time and energy to accompany their children.

p113.original: 总体而言，教养方式的研究从两个基本维度来归纳不同的教养行为：父母的接纳，包括养育、情感投入和对儿童观点的敏感性；父母的控制，这是指做决定时父母和儿童所参与的程度。基于这两个维度，你能指出4种不同的教养方式分别是接纳和控制这两个维度怎样的组合吗？请查看表7-3来核对你的答案。
p113.en: In general, studies of correctional practices summarize different forms of parenting from two basic dimensions: parental acceptance, including parenting, emotional input and sensitivity to the child's perspective; Parental control, which refers to the extent to which parents and children are involved in making decisions. On the basis of these two dimensions, can you point out how the four different forms of upbringing combine acceptance and control of these two dimensions? Please check your answers with Table 7-3.

p114.original: 表7-34 种教养方式和它们的维度

p115.original: 你可能会猜到这些不同教养方式的通常效果。研究显示权威型父母教养的孩子比较自信、自立和热诚。总体而言，这些孩子更加快乐，更少有麻烦，也更成功。宽容型和忽视型父母教养的孩子通常不成熟，更易冲动，依赖性强，并且要求更高。专制型父母教养的孩子更加焦虑，缺乏安全感。事实上，在某些情况下，专制型教养方式可能是反社会行为的一个风险因素。一项开创性研究考察了教养方式和依恋类型对儿童表现的共同影响。结果发现了什么？对于不安全型依恋的孩子，专制型教养方式增加了他们日后出现反社会行为的风险。另一方面，安全型依恋的儿童能够容忍专制型教养方式而不会变成仇视社会的人。研究人员认为，安全型依恋起到了保护作用，使得儿童认为父母的严厉教导行为是出于善意而不是威胁——而不安全型依恋的孩子则认为严厉教导是威胁（Kochanska et al.，2009）。
p115.en: You might guess the usual effect of these different forms of upbringing. Research shows that children raised by authoritative parents are more confident, self-reliant and committed. In general, these children are happier, less troubled and more successful. Children raised by tolerant and neglected parents are usually premature, more impulsive, dependent and more demanding. Children raised by despotic parents are more anxious and insecure. In fact, in some cases, autocratic forms of correction may be a risk factor for anti-social behaviour. A groundbreaking study examined the combined effects of correctional practices and types of attachment on the performance of children. What did you find out? For unsafe dependent children, authoritarian upbringing increases the risk of future anti-social behaviour. On the other hand, safe-type dependent children can tolerate authoritarian forms of upbringing without becoming socially hostile. Researchers believe that safety-type attachments serve a protective function, leading children to believe that parents' harsh teaching behaviour is motivated by goodwill rather than by threats - while unsafe-type attachments view harsh teaching as a threat (Kochanska et al., 2009).

p116.original: 根据我们对依恋的了解，这些发现不足为奇。一般来说，相比较其他3种类型的父母，权威型父母在儿童的生活中参与得更多，也与儿童有更多的互动，使儿童形成了一种更强烈的社会情感的依恋。这为儿童发展过程中的亲社会行为奠定了坚实的基础。
p116.en: According to our knowledge of attachment, these findings are not surprising. In general, authoritative parents are more involved and interact more with children than with the other three types of parents, resulting in a stronger attachment to social sentiment. This provides a solid foundation for pro-social behaviour in children's development.

p117.original: 文化和教养方式 早期的教养方式研究很多是在西方中产阶级文化中进行的。在其他地方会有类似的发现吗？你是怎么看的？
p117.en: Cultural and correctional approaches. Early methods of upbringing are much studied in Western middle-class cultures. Is there anything like that anywhere else? What do you think?

p118.original: 最近的研究表明，文化确实在教养方式和教养效果方面发挥了作用，但它的作用方式与你想象的不同。中国、西班牙和亚太国家的父母都倾向于用比西方父母更为严格的教养方式，大体上看起来，这可能更像专制型教养方式。然而，细看就会发现这些父母在要求子女遵守严厉规则并尊重父母的同时还给予了子女大量的关爱——尤其是来自父亲的关爱。由于这两者同时出现，这些儿童就和西方国家的权威型父母培养的儿童一样，有着积极的表现（Berk，2007）。在美国，低社会经济地位的非裔美国家庭对子女施加高强度的控制也会取得积极成效：和没有接受严格管教的儿童相比，这些儿童在学校和在同伴中表现得更好（Taylor et al.，1995）。因此，最佳教养方式在某种程度上取决于主流文化以及所处环境的规则、习俗和挑战。
p118.en: Recent studies have shown that culture does play a role in upbringing and its effects, but it does so in a different way than you think. Parents in China, Spain and Asia-Pacific countries tend to be brought up in a more rigorous manner than Western parents, which may generally appear to be more like authoritarian. However, a closer look reveals that these parents, while demanding strict rules and respect for their parents, give a great deal of care to their children — especially from their fathers. As a result of both, these children have had positive performances, as have children raised by authoritative parents in Western countries (Berk, 2007). In the United States, high levels of control exercised by low-economic African-American families over their children are also positive: these children are better represented in school and among their peers than children who are not under strict discipline (Taylor et al., 1995). Thus, the best form of upbringing depends to some extent on the rules, customs and challenges of the dominant culture and the environment.

p119.original: 托儿所的作用 随着上班的父母日益依赖托儿所来照料子女，很多人都会关注以下问题：儿童是否有必要有一个全职照料者？这个问题在很多国家，包括美国，都是一个紧迫的问题。在美国，有71%的母亲外出上班（Cohn et al.，2014），并且越来越多的父母请人照顾子女，而不是由亲属照顾子女（U.S.Department of Health and Human Services，2009）。
p119.en: As working parents become more dependent on day-care centres for their children, many are concerned about the question of whether children need a full-time caregiver. This issue is an urgent one in many countries, including the United States. In the United States, 71 per cent of mothers go to work (Cohn et al., 2014), and increasingly parents ask to take care of their children rather than by relatives (U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 2009).

p120.original: 一般来说，上班族父母可以放心：大部分儿童都可以在托儿所茁壮成长。不管是在智力水平还是社交能力上，托儿所的孩子都和全职父母教养的孩子表现一样好，有时甚至更好。而且，上班族妈妈带大的孩子长大之后在他们自己的职业生涯和人际关系中受益良多。一项涉及25个国家有超过50 000名被试的研究发现，上班族妈妈的女儿比非上班族妈妈的女儿所受教育的程度更高，收入也更高。儿子也会从工作的父母那里受益，不过方式不同：数据显示，与受到全职妈妈照顾的儿子相比，上班族妈妈的儿子长大之后会花更多的时间照顾自己的子女和参与家务劳动——这可以解释为什么他们拥有更高的亲密关系满意度（Miller，2015）。
p120.en: In general, working parents can rest assured that most children can thrive in nurseries. Children in nurseries are as good, and sometimes even better, as children in full-time parental care, both at intellectual and social level. Moreover, working mothers bring their children to grow up and benefit greatly from their own professional and personal relationships. A study involving more than 50,000 tested in 25 countries found that the daughters of working mothers were more educated and earning more than the daughters of non-working mothers. Boys also benefit from working parents, although in different ways: data show that a working mother's son spends more time caring for his children and taking part in domestic work than a son who is in full-time care of a mother - which explains why they are more satisfied with intimate relationships (Miller, 2015).

p121.original: 不过，托儿所的质量至关重要。劣质托儿所会使儿童变得好斗、抑郁或适应不良。当你寻找托儿所时如何区分优质和劣质托儿所呢？专家指出有3个关键因素要考虑。
p121.en: However, the quality of day-care centres is crucial. Poor-quality nurseries can make children aggressive, depressed or poorly adapted. How do you distinguish between high-quality and poor-quality day care when you look for a day-care centre? The experts noted three key factors to be considered.

p122.original: 1. 优质托儿所的照料者与儿童的互动更加频繁，并且对儿童的需求敏感，能够积极回应。
p122.en: 1. Caregivers of quality childcare centres interact more frequently with children and are sensitive to their needs and are able to respond positively.

p123.original: 2. 优质托儿所的照料者/儿童的比率更低[2]，这样每个照料者就都有足够的时间和精力照顾每一个儿童。
p123.en: 2. The rate of caregiver/child in quality nurseries is even lower so that every caregiver has sufficient time and energy to care for every child.

p124.original: 3. 最后，优质托儿所的照料者的受教育程度更高。
p124.en: 3. Finally, the caregiver of a quality nursery is better educated.

p125.original: 幸运的是，正在进行的美国全国儿童保育研究表明，大部分托儿所都做得很好（Bower，1996；NICHD Early Child Care Research Network，2003，2007）。
p125.en: Fortunately, the ongoing national childcare study in the United States shows that most nurseries are doing well (Bower, 1996); NICHD Earth Child Care Research Network, 2003.

p126.original: 闲暇时间的影响 美国和其他工业化国家的儿童和青少年比世界上其他地区的儿童和青少年有更多的自由时间。在非工业化社会，儿童平均要花6小时进行家务劳动或工作。相比之下，美国儿童花在这类事情上的时间则不到30分钟。另外，和过去相比，美国儿童平均花在家庭作业上的时间更多了——虽然还是少于其他工业化国家的儿童。总体而言，几代人以来，美国儿童的闲暇时间增长得非常快（Larson，2001）。平均而言，今天的美国儿童将40%～50%的醒着的时间用于可自由支配的活动。
p126.en: The impact of leisure time is that children and adolescents in the United States and other industrialized countries have more free time than in other parts of the world. In non-industrialized societies, children spend an average of six hours on domestic work or work. In contrast, United States children spend less than 30 minutes on such matters. Moreover, on average, children in the United States spend more time than in the past on homework — though still less than children in other industrialized countries. Overall, the leisure time of children in the United States has grown very rapidly for generations (Larsen, 2001). On average, today's American children spend 40 to 50 per cent of their awakening time on discretionary activities.

p127.original: 儿童和青少年如何度过他们的闲暇时光？大部分时间被花在了媒体上，包括看电视、玩视频游戏、玩计算机或其他电子设备（Rideout et al.，2010）。阅读作为一项娱乐活动的受欢迎程度是中等的，并且更受女孩的欢迎。随着儿童进入青春期，娱乐性阅读的受欢迎程度会下降，不管是对女孩还是男孩而言都是如此（Nippold et al.，2005）。随着儿童年龄的增长，他们玩耍的时间减少，取而代之的是在媒体上的活动，他们通常会和朋友一起参与这些活动。
p127.en: How do children and adolescents spend their leisure time? Much of the time has been spent on the media, including watching television, playing video games, playing computers or other electronic devices (Rideout et al., 2010). Reading as a recreational activity is popular to a medium degree and is more popular to girls. As children enter adolescence, the popularity of recreational reading decreases, both for girls and boys (Nippold et al., 2005). As children grow older, they have less time to play, replacing them with media events, in which they usually participate with friends.

p128.original: 儿童和青少年平均每天花在媒体上的时间是8小时。这是他们花在朋友和家庭上的时间的2倍，是他们花在锻炼、阅读和做作业上的时间的6倍。
p128.en: On average, children and adolescents spend eight hours a day in the media. This is twice the time they spend on friends and families, and six times the time they spend on exercise, reading and doing homework.

p129.original: 闲暇时间的这些活动对儿童的发展有什么影响？研究结果莫衷一是。不管是哪个年龄段，与朋友相处的时间都和幸福感有关（Rawlins，1992），并且这种朋友间的交往在青春期尤为重要。儿童和青少年每日的运动时间平均只有1小时，但是运动对健康有明显的好处，并且依据运动的类型和所处的环境，运动还有利于培养领导力、合作能力和动机。电视的影响是过去几十年来人们密切关注的话题，目前看来其作用似乎主要依赖于儿童观看节目的类型。教育类电视节目大约占儿童观看总量的25%，其对儿童的读写和认知发展有积极作用（Linebarger et al.，2004）。再者，大量观看娱乐节目是年幼儿童阅读能力发展落后的一个重要预测指标（Ennemoser & Schneider，2007）。成百上千项研究发现，观看暴力电视毫无疑问会增加观看者的攻击性行为（Strasburger，1995）。而且，3岁之前观看任何类型的娱乐电视节目都与儿童后期的注意问题密切相关（Zimmerman & Christakis，2007）。我们将在本阶段末尾的“心理学很有用”版块探讨相关的机制。
p129.en: What are the impacts of leisure-time activities on children's development? The results are mixed. At any age, the time spent with friends is related to happiness (Rawlins, 1992) and this kind of friendship is particularly important in adolescence. On average, children and adolescents spend only one hour per day in sports, but sports have obvious benefits for their health and, depending on the type of sport and the circumstances in which it is carried out, they also contribute to the development of leadership, cooperation and motivation. The impact of television has been the subject of close attention over the past decades, and its role now appears to depend mainly on the type of programmes children watch. Television programmes in the education sector account for approximately 25 per cent of the total number of children viewed and have a positive impact on children's literacy and cognitive development (Linebarger et al., 2004). Moreover, the large number of viewers of entertainment programmes is an important predictive indicator of the backwardness of young children's reading skills (Ennemoser & Schneider, 2007). Hundreds of studies have found that watching violent television undoubtedly increases the aggressive behaviour of viewers (Strasburger, 1995). Moreover, watching any type of entertainment television before the age of 3 is closely related to the issue of late childhood attention (Zimmerman & Christakis, 2007). At the end of this phase, we will explore the mechanisms in the “Psychological Useful” section.

p130.original: 和观看暴力电视节目相似，玩带有暴力内容的视频游戏也会影响儿童的攻击性。此外，研究还发现，暴力视频游戏会减少玩家对真实世界暴力的敏感性（Carnagey et al.，2007），并会减少亲社会（助人）行为（Anderson & Bushman，2001）。另外，频繁玩视频游戏会提升视觉空间的加工能力（Green & Bavelier，2007）。不是所有的视频游戏都是暴力的。教育类视频游戏能提升儿童的批判性思维能力，促进儿童对不同学科（从社会学科到数学）的学习。再次强调一下，这里传达的信息很清楚：媒体的内容才是真正的关键点，而不是媒体本身。
p130.en: Similar to watching violent television programmes, video games with violent content can affect the aggressive nature of children. In addition, studies have found that violent video games reduce the vulnerability of players to violence in the real world (Carnagey et al., 2007) and reduce pro-social (helping) behaviour (Anderson & Bushman, 2001). In addition, frequent video games enhance the processing capacity of the visual space (Green & Bavelier, 2007). Not all video games are violent. Educational video games can enhance children's critical thinking skills and promote their learning of different disciplines, from social studies to mathematics. Once again, the message is clear: the media content is the real key point, not the media itself.

p131.original: 社会化中的性别差异 观察过小男孩和小女孩玩耍的人都会注意到，在儿童的社交互动中存在性别差异。孩子通常都会偏好与同性别的孩子一起玩——在不同文化中都存在这种模式（Maccoby，1998，2000）。在玩耍中，男孩通常比女孩更具攻击性，虽然也有一些例外。女孩倾向于建立小的合作群体。相反，男孩经常会形成更大的群体，其内部具有层级结构或“权力等级”。在这些群体里，男孩子们不断竞争以获取更高等级的地位。他们经常采取攻击性策略，如拍打、推搡和口头威胁等。在休闲活动的选择上，性别差异也很明显。在业余时间，男孩们更喜欢运动和电子游戏，而女孩们更喜欢看电视（Cherney & London，2006）。
p131.en: Gender differences in socialization are observed by people who watch young boys and young girls play, and there are gender differences in children's social interactions. Children usually prefer to play with children of the same sex - a pattern that exists in different cultures (Maccoby, 1998, 2000). In play, boys are usually more aggressive than girls, although there are some exceptions. Girls tend to establish small groups of partners. On the contrary, boys often form a larger group, with a hierarchy or “power hierarchy” within it. Among these groups, boys and girls are constantly competing to attain higher status. They often resort to aggressive tactics, such as beating, pushing and verbal threats. Gender differences are also evident in the choice of leisure activities. In amateur hours, boys prefer sports and video games, while girls prefer to watch television (Cherney & London, 2006).

p132.original: 进化心理学家相信这些性别差异具有先天的基础（Buss，1999），这些差异可能部分与睾酮水平的性别差异有关（Dabbs，2000）。当然，这并不意味着环境因素，如教养方式和同伴影响，不会起作用。社会认知理论家凯·伯西和阿尔伯特·班杜拉（Bussey & Bandura，1999）提醒我们，儿童从他们的社会环境和角色模型中学习性别角色和性别相关的行为，如进取心、竞争力和合作。
p132.en: Evolutionary psychologists believe that these gender differences have a natural basis (Buss, 1999) and that they may be partly related to gender differences in testosterone levels (Dabs, 2000). Of course, this does not mean that environmental factors, such as upbringing and peer influence, will not work. Social cognitive theorists Kai Percy and Albert Bandura remind us that children learn gender roles and gender-related behaviours from their social context and role models, such as motivation, competitiveness and cooperation.

p133.original: 7.6.3 儿童期的社会心理发展：埃里克森的阶段理论
p133.en: 7.6.3 Psychosocial development in childhood: Eriksson's Phase Theory

p134.original: 埃里克·埃里克森的毕生发展理论提出了我们在人生中会遇到的8项基本挑战或社会心理阶段。第一个阶段，信任对不信任，发生在0岁到1.5岁之间，与儿童依恋的发展时期相重合。在儿童期，个体会再经历3个埃里克森提出的阶段，每次都会遇到一个新的“紧要关头”，并且发展他们关于自己以及自己与世界之间的关系图式中的一个关键成分。这些阶段揭示了儿童眼中世界的不同方面。
p134.en: Eric Eriksen's life-long development theory sets out eight basic challenges or psychosocial stages that we will face in our lives. In the first stage, trust and mistrust occurred between the ages of 0 and 1.5, which coincided with the development of a child's attachment. In childhood, individuals go through three more stages proposed by Eriksson, each time encounter a new “critical juncture” and develop a key element in their pattern of relations with themselves and with the world. These stages reveal the different aspects of the world in the eyes of children.

p135.original: 自主对害羞或自我怀疑 处于第二个阶段（18个月到3岁之间）的儿童正在迅速学习走路和说话。他们与世界互动水平的提高，使得他们有机会直接影响事情的结果。为了培养独立或自主性——这个阶段的主要发展任务——儿童需要在合适的时机自由（有时候需要鼓励）尝试自己做事。过多的限制和批评会导致他们自我怀疑，而过早提出苛刻的要求，例如，在儿童还没准备好之前，就让他们尝试进行如厕训练，会导致儿童产生羞耻感，并失去在新任务中努力学习的信心；因此，这个阶段的名称是自主对害羞或自我怀疑。父母可以通过鼓励儿童尽力尝试，提供温和的有建设性的指导，以及表扬他们的努力和成功，来帮助儿童发展自主性。相比于在第一阶段没有培养出信任感的儿童，那些对世界抱有普遍信任感的儿童更可能成功地培养自主性。
p135.en: Children in the second stage (18 months to 3 years of age) are learning to walk and speak quickly. The increased level of their interaction with the world gives them the opportunity to directly influence the outcome. In order to foster independence or autonomy — the main development task at this stage — children need to be free (and sometimes encouraged) to try to do their own work at the right time. Excessive restrictions and criticism can lead to self-doubt and premature imposition of harsh demands, such as allowing children to try to practice toilet training before they are ready, which can lead to a sense of shame on the part of children and a loss of confidence in learning in new assignments; Thus, the title of this phase is autonomy to shyness or self-doubt. Parents can help children to develop their autonomy by encouraging them to try, providing moderate and constructive guidance and commending their efforts and successes. Children with a general sense of trust in the world are more likely to succeed in developing autonomy than those who did not develop a sense of trust in the first phase.

p136.original: 在这个阶段，儿童首先要发展对世界的控制感。如厕训练是一个关键节点，它会使儿童变得自主和独立。这个时期中的严厉批评和不切实际的期望，会使儿童产生羞愧和自我怀疑，而不是拥有自主性。
p136.en: At this stage, children first have to develop a sense of control over the world. The training of toilets is a key node that makes children autonomous and independent. Rigorous criticism and unrealistic expectations during this period can lead to shame and self-doubt rather than autonomy for children.

p137.original: 虽然埃里克森并没有强调气质在社会心理发展中的作用，但我们应该指出它的影响：我们会预期，害羞的孩子比大胆的孩子更需要温柔的鼓励。因此，虽然后天支持性的环境是发展自主性的关键因素，但是天性也会起到一定的作用。
p137.en: While Eriksson does not emphasize the role of temperament in psychosocial development, we should point out its impact: we will expect that shy children need more tender encouragement than bold ones. Thus, although a supportive environment is a key factor in development autonomy, nature also plays a role.

p138.original: 主动对内疚 一旦儿童发展了信任和自主性，他面临的第三项挑战是培养主动性（initiative）或自发开展活动的能力，而不仅仅是对他人的响应。在学龄前，具有主动性的儿童会变得更有目的性，他们想要自己选择穿什么、吃什么，或者如何打发时间。这个阶段的危险因素来自过度控制的成年人，他们可能会对儿童提出不切实际的自我控制要求（如为什么你不能安安静静地坐着），这些要求会导致儿童觉得自己能力不足并产生内疚感。这个阶段的术语反映了两种可能的结果：主动对内疚。照料者对孩子主动行为的反应将鼓励或阻碍他们自由和自信的发展，而这两者正是他们下一个阶段发展所需要的。
p138.en: The third challenge for a child once he or she develops trust and autonomy is to develop the capacity to engage in initiative or spontaneous activity, not just to respond to others. Before school age, active children become more purposeful and want to choose what to wear, what to eat, or how to spend time. The risk factor at this stage comes from over-controlled adults, who may impose unrealistic self-control requirements on children (e.g. why you cannot sit quietly), which can lead children to feel under-capacity and feel guilty. The terminology at this stage reflects two possible outcomes: active guilt. The reaction of caregivers to the child's initiative will encourage or hinder their free and self-confidence, both of which are needed for their next stage of development.

p139.original: 儿童扩展了他们的自主性，现在开始实践自己的主动性，想要在活动和人际关系中做出自己的选择。在这个阶段限制或批评儿童的选择，会使儿童产生内疚感。相反，对好奇心和创造力的鼓励将会培养儿童的主动性。
p139.en: Children have expanded their autonomy and are beginning to exercise their initiative to make their own choices in their activities and interpersonal relationships. Limiting or criticizing children's choices at this stage can create a sense of guilt. On the contrary, encouragement of curiosity and creativity will foster children's initiative.

p140.original: 勤奋对自卑 成功掌握埃里克森前三个阶段的技能后，儿童将进入小学，并且开始更系统地发展他们的技能和胜任感。从6岁到12岁，校园活动和各种运动为儿童学习更复杂的智力和运动技能提供了适宜的场所，而同伴间的互动为他们发展社交能力提供了机会。为了获得成功和胜任感，孩子们需要付出努力，埃里克森称之为勤奋（industry）。在这个阶段，支持性的教养方式有助于儿童对自己的经验进行反省，从他们的成功和失败中学习，并认识到有些失败是不可避免的。另一方面，过度控制或者忽视型父母所培养的儿童，则无法正确地看待他们的失败，并且最终产生自卑感。与之类似，在一个或多个早期阶段碰到问题的孩子可能会成为一个气馁的观众而不是一个参与者，并且产生自卑感而不是胜任感。因此，这个阶段的术语是勤奋对自卑。
p140.en: Having successfully acquired the skills of Eriksen in the first three stages, children will enter primary school and begin to develop their skills and competencies more systematically. From the age of 6 to 12, school activities and sports provide suitable venues for children to learn more complex intellectual and sports skills, while peer-to-peer interaction provides opportunities for them to develop their social skills. In order to be successful and competent, children need to work hard, as Eriksson calls it hard work (industry). At this stage, supportive forms of upbringing help children to reflect on their experiences, learn from their successes and failures and recognize that some failures are inevitable. On the other hand, children who are over-controlled or neglected are unable to see their failures correctly and ultimately have a sense of inferiority. Similarly, children who encounter problems at one or more early stages may become a discouraged audience rather than a participant, and have a sense of inferiority rather than competence. The term at this stage is therefore one of diligence and inferiority.

p141.original: 总之，我们已经了解了语言、认知技能和社交能力如何在儿童的快速成长和变化中交互发展。个体依照普遍的生理时间表在每个领域取得进步，但是其进步的速度和性质会受到环境的显著影响。
p141.en: In conclusion, we have learned how languages, cognitive skills and social skills can interact in the rapid growth and change of children. Individuals progress in each area according to a universal biological timetable, but the speed and nature of their progress are significantly affected by the environment.

p143.en: Reflections on the development of children

p144.original: 如我们所知，儿童期是很多领域发展的高峰期。请回顾你在本阶段学到的关于这个重要时期的所有内容，回答如下问题：你最先想到的是哪些新知识？为什么？
p144.en: As we know, childhood is the peak of development in many areas. Please recall all the information you have learned at this stage about this important period, and answer the following question: What is the new knowledge you first thought of? Why?

p145.en: Psychology is a good ADH puzzle.

p146.original: 注意缺陷/多动障碍（attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder，ADHD）是一种心理障碍。在美国学龄儿童中其发病率为5%～7%，并且不同文化中的发病率非常相似，约为5%（Polanczyk et al.，2007，2014；Willcutt，2012）。ADHD的症状主要有两类：躯体症状包括多动和冲动，认知症状包括认知混乱和注意力不集中（见图7-6）。因此，ADHD患者通常表现为难以控制冲动、不能长时间专注于某一任务、注意力分散和多动。虽然男孩和女孩都可能患有ADHD，但是男孩的症状更加明显，他们可能会频繁地在课堂上离开座位、抢答或插话。女孩的ADHD症状更多的是注意力不集中，而不是身体多动。因此，患ADHD的女孩可能只表现出认知混乱和健忘。症状的差异可能也会影响诊断，女孩仅占ADHD诊断病例的20%，一些研究人员怀疑不同性别患者数量的差异，可能部分来自症状表现的性别差异（Skogli et al.，2013）。
p146.en: Attention to impairment/multiactivity disorder (attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, ADHD) is a psychological disorder. The prevalence rate among school-age children in the United States is between 5 and 7 per cent, and is very similar across cultures, about 5 per cent (Polanczyk et al., 2007, 2014); Willcutt, 2012. The symptoms of ADHD are of two main types: body symptoms include hyperactivity and impulses, and cognitive symptoms include cognitive confusion and low concentration (see figures 7-6). Thus, ADHD patients are often shown to be impulsive, unable to focus on a particular task for long periods of time, distracted and motivated. Although both boys and girls may have ADHD, the symptoms are more pronounced for boys, who may often leave their seats, answering or interrogating in the classroom. The ADHD symptoms for girls are more of a lack of focus than of physical mobility. As a result, girls suffering from ADHD may only show confusion and memory. Disparities in symptoms may also affect diagnosis, with girls accounting for only 20 per cent of ADH diagnostic cases, and some researchers suspect that differences in the number of patients of different genders may be partly due to gender differences in symptoms (Skogli et al., 2013).

p148.original: 注：DSM-5为心理学家和精神病学家提供了行业认可的指南，以有效且准确地诊断心理障碍。在这里，你可以查看ADHD的诊断标准。
p148.en: Note: DSM-5 provides a professionally recognized guide for psychologists and psychiatrists to effectively and accurately diagnose psychological disorders. Here, you can look at the ADHD diagnostic criteria.

p149.original: 不论是男孩还是女孩，患者在生活的各个方面都存在困难，经常会导致学业成绩差以及和同伴关系不稳定。事实上，病症对生活各个方面都会产生影响是ADHD的诊断指标之一。我们有必要区分真正的ADHD和普通生活压力导致的症状表现或儿童正常发展中的某些特征。症状也必须明显超越该年龄段儿童与其年龄所适宜的表现。这种障碍似乎遵循某种可预测的发展路径，其症状在儿童早期就会出现，并且大约有50%的案例在进入青春期后症状就自行消失了。然而，有30%的诊断为ADHD的儿童或青少年在成年后仍将与这种病症做斗争（Lara et al.，2012）。更重要的是，超过半数的ADHD成人患者（他们中的一些人没有得到合适的治疗）还有至少一种心理障碍，并且这些个体具有更高的药物和酒精滥用的风险，自杀风险也更高（Barbaresi et al.，2013）。显然，适宜的诊断和治疗是有效管理这种障碍的关键。
p149.en: Both boys and girls experience difficulties in all aspects of life, often leading to poor academic performance and unstable peer relationships. In fact, the effect of the disease on all aspects of life is one of the diagnostic indicators of ADHD. It is necessary to distinguish between the symptoms of real ADH and ordinary life stress or some of the characteristics of normal child development. Symptoms must also be significantly greater than those of children of that age who are suitable for their age. Such barriers appear to follow a predictable development path, with symptoms occurring early in childhood and in about 50 per cent of cases becoming self-discovery after adolescence. However, 30 per cent of children or adolescents diagnosed as ADHD will continue to fight this disease as adults (Lara et al., 2012). More importantly, more than half of ADHD adults (some of whom do not receive proper treatment) have at least one mental disorder, and these individuals are at higher risk of drug and alcohol abuse and suicide (Barbaresi et al., 2013). It is clear that proper diagnosis and treatment are key to the effective management of such barriers.

p151.original: 对ADHD成因的研究尚处于早期阶段，尽管双生子研究和其他遗传研究指出它存在很强的遗传成分（Barkley，2014）。ADHD大脑和正常大脑在生理上有何区别呢？一个重要的区别是神经递质多巴胺（当一个人从事感兴趣的任务时体内会分泌多巴胺）（Spencer et al.，2013）。ADHD个体接收到的多巴胺比较少或比较弱，这与他们的任务参与度较低，并且更难在任务中维持长时间的兴趣有关。大脑结构的发展似乎也在其中起一定作用：虽然早期研究表明，ADHD患者的大脑比非ADHD者的小，但是新近的研究表明，这种差异通常只是时间问题。绝大部分ADHD个体的大脑正常发育，并且也能达到正常大小——他们只是需要更长的时间而已。一个关键发现是，ADHD患者大脑前额皮层的发育滞后的时间可能长达5年（Shaw et al.2012），这与ADHD患者有执行功能（例如，在要求计划和跟进的多步骤任务中保持专注）困难相符。有趣的是，ADHD患者的运动皮层实际上比正常个体发育得更快，研究人员认为这可以解释ADHD患者的多动行为特征（Shaw and others，2007）。总之，ADHD患者的大脑虽然发育比较慢，但是最终会发育正常，这一发现可能可以解释为什么有些ADHD儿童在青春期的某一个时间点突然间痊愈了。
p151.en: The study of the cause of ADHD is still in its early stages, despite the fact that twin and other genetic studies indicate that it has a strong genetic component (Barkley, 2014). What difference does the ADHD brain make from the normal brain? An important difference is the neurotransmittance of dopamine (dopamine is administered in the body when a person is engaged in an interested mission) (Spencer et al., 2013). ADHD individuals receive less or less dopamine, which is related to the low level of participation in their missions and the difficulty of maintaining long-term interest in them. The development of brain structures seems to have played a role in this: although early studies have shown that ADH patients have smaller brains than non-ADH people, recent studies have shown that this difference is usually only a matter of time. The majority of ADHD individuals have normal brain growth and can reach normal size -- they just take longer. A key finding is that the developmental delay in the front cortex of the brain of ADH patients may be up to five years (Shaw et al. 2012), which is consistent with the difficulty of ADH patients having performance functions (e.g. maintaining a focus on multi-step tasks requiring planning and follow-up). Interestingly, the sports cortex of ADH patients is actually growing faster than normal individuals, which researchers believe can explain the dynamics of ADH patients (Shaw and others, 2007). Overall, the fact that the ADHD patients ' brain, although slow, eventually developed normal may explain why some ADH children suddenly recovered at some point in adolescence.

p152.original: 从后天角度看，母亲产前接触尼古丁和酒精会增加儿童ADHD的发病率。虽然某些环境因素（如高糖饮食）引起ADHD的理论已经被证实并不成立，但是最近的研究有一些关于儿童环境的启发性的发现。如我们所知，生命最初几年是大脑以惊人速度建立突触连接的时期。我们也知道，大脑会根据经验来建立连接。观看快节奏的媒体是否会使得年轻的大脑更偏好快速变化的刺激呢？最近一篇包含45项研究的综述考察了这一可能性，并得出结论，这可能是真的（Nikkelen et al.，2014）。一项纵向研究发现，儿童在3岁前观看非教育类电视节目越多，他在随后的儿童期出现注意缺陷的风险就越大（Zimmerman & Christakis，2007）。研究人员认为，快节奏的娱乐节目确实造成了这一结果：换句话说，在大脑连接形成的时期观看快节奏的、频繁切换场景的电视节目，会导致大脑难以建立提升注意范围和集中注意的大脑通路。相反，电视节目会训练大脑去寻求快速变化的刺激。这样，我们很容易理解电视节目会如何使儿童在随后的生活中出现注意广度的问题。这也解释了为什么观看相同数量的教育类电视节目（这类节目场景变化慢）不会增加儿童期的注意缺陷发病率。这项研究控制了其他可能影响注意缺陷发生的因素，如家庭环境、教养方式和认知刺激等。根据一项有关陪伴的研究，90%的小于24个月的儿童经常观看电视，并且他们观看的电视节目中有半数是娱乐节目（Zimmerman et al.，2007）。
p152.en: From a later point of view, prenatal exposure of mothers to nicotine and alcohol increases the incidence of ADH in children. Although the theory that certain environmental factors (such as high sugar diets) cause ADHD has not been proven valid, recent studies have revealed some instructive findings about the environment of children. As we know, the first few years of life are the period when the brain creates synapses at alarming speeds. And we also know that the brain builds connections based on experience. Will watching fast-paced media make young brains more responsive to rapid-change stimulation? A recent overview of 45 studies examines this possibility and concludes that this may be true (Nikkelen et al., 2014). A longitudinal study found that the more children watch non-education television programmes before they reach the age of 3, the greater the risk of their being sensitized to deficiencies in subsequent childhood (Zimmerman & Christakis, 2007). Researchers believe that fast-paced entertainment programmes do result in this result: in other words, watching fast-paced, frequent-to-scene television programmes during the period when brain connections are formed, can make it difficult for the brain to establish brain circuits that increase attention and focus attention. Instead, television programmes train the brain to seek rapid change incentives. In this way, it is easy to understand how television programmes can give rise to the issue of the breadth of attention to children in their subsequent lives. This also explains why watching the same number of educational television programmes (which are slow to change) does not increase the incidence of childhood neglect. The study controls other factors that may affect the occurrence of deficiencies, such as the family environment, upbringing and cognitive stimulation. According to a study on companionship, 90 per cent of children under 24 months of age regularly watch television and half of the television programmes they watch are entertainment programmes (Zimmerman et al., 2007).

p154.original: 药物治疗和心理治疗对于ADHD都是有效的，但是最佳治疗方法因人而异。对很多人而言，药物治疗效果很好，但是我们强烈推荐为每一位患者都配备一名ADHD专业治疗师进行仔细监测和管理，以确保患者使用正确的药物和剂量。同时，有研究推荐定期进行“退出”检测来确定儿童是否仍然需要药物治疗（Swanson et al.，2007a）——当然，退出必须在处方药剂师的严格监督下进行。
p154.en: Drug and psychological treatment is effective for ADHD, but the best treatment varies from person to person. For many people, drug treatment works well, but we strongly recommend that each patient be carefully monitored and managed by an ADHD specialist to ensure that the patient is using the right drugs and doses. At the same time, studies have recommended periodic “exit” tests to determine whether a child still needs medication (Swanson et al., 2007a) - of course, withdrawal must be carried out under the strict supervision of a prescription pharmacist.

p155.original: 或者，也可以采用行为疗法来帮助ADHD儿童学会控制某些问题行为，并选择用更有效的行为来替代问题行为——例如，学会识别冲动并且在采取冲动行为之前从1数到10。父母和其他家庭成员是达成有效行为治疗效果的关键后盾。父母可以设定清晰的期望，并使用操作条件反射的原则，一步一个脚印地塑造儿童的行为。当儿童没有注意到每一步的成功，或者成功未对他产生强化作用时，每个家庭成员都可以重新引导他。然而，与任何类型的行为矫正计划一样，保持一致是很重要的，这意味着家庭必须优先安排治疗所需要的时间和精力，以确保治疗效果。当家庭已经面临多项任务和重要事项时，这可能就是一个挑战。
p155.en: Alternatively, behavioural therapy can be used to help ADH children learn to control certain problematic behaviours and choose to replace them with more effective behaviours — for example, learning to recognize impulses and counting from 1 to 10 before they take on impulses. Parents and other family members are the key backstops for achieving effective behavioural therapy. Parents can set clear expectations and use the principle of operational reflexes to shape the behaviour of children step by step. When the child is not aware of the success of each step, or when success does not strengthen him, every family member can redirect him. However, consistency is important, as is any type of behavioural correction plan, which means that families must prioritize the time and effort required for treatment to ensure its effectiveness. This may be a challenge when families already face multiple tasks and important matters.

p156.original: ADHD的行为治疗包括制定清晰的预期目标和规则。这位家长正在用一张家务列表，帮助他女儿学习井井有条地做事。日常体育锻炼、充足的睡眠和营养也是非常重要的。
p156.en: ADHD behaviour therapy includes the development of clear expected objectives and rules. The parent is using a list of household chores to help her daughter to learn how to do her work in a structured manner. Day-to-day physical exercise, adequate sleep and nutrition are also important.

p157.original: 行为治疗是针对年幼儿童的首选治疗方法（并不推荐对他们进行药物干预）。并且，对于刚刚出现ADHD症状的个体，行为治疗可能是初始治疗的最佳选择；之后，如果症状没有改善，可以将药物加入治疗计划中。对于很多案例来说，药物和行为治疗相结合能取得最好的效果（Shaw et al.，2012）。
p157.en: Behavioural treatment is the preferred treatment for young children (no drug intervention is recommended). Furthermore, behavioural therapy may be the best option for initial treatment for individuals who have just emerged with ADHD symptoms; Thereafter, if symptoms do not improve, the drug can be added to the treatment plan. In many cases, the combination of drugs and behavioural therapy is the best (Shaw et al., 2012).

p159.original: 与大多数偏离“正常”的行为模式一样，对ADHD的研究和讨论都倾向于认为ADHD是一个必须被矫正的问题。然而，最近在某些研究圈子中出现了另一种观点，认为应该更加辩证地看待这种障碍。
p159.en: As with most deviations from “normal” patterns of behaviour, the research and discussion of ADHD tends to consider ADHD as a problem that must be corrected. However, a different view emerged recently in some research circles that such obstacles should be viewed more convincingly.

p160.original: 我们必须牢记，ADHD儿童拥有很多积极特质。他们思想更加自由奔放、好奇、精力充沛、幽默风趣，也更加聪明和有创造力。他们的行为经常是自发的、有益的和敏感的。许多ADHD儿童是富有天分的多任务工作者、最后一分钟专家和即兴表演者。父母和教育工作者应该鼓励孩子的这些长处，并让孩子知道他们的这些品质非常有价值（Rothenberger & Banaschewski，2007）。
p160.en: We must remember that ADHD children have many positive qualities. They are more freer, more curious, more energetic, more humorous and more intelligent and creative. Their behaviour is often spontaneous, useful and sensitive. Many ADHD children are talented multi-task workers, last-minute experts and improvists. Parents and educators should encourage these strengths of their children and make them aware of their value (Rothenberger & Banaschewski, 2007).

p161.original: 事实上，有人认为阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦、列奥纳多·达·芬奇、比尔·克林顿（Bill Clinton）和沃尔特·迪士尼（Walt Disney）都有ADHD症状。企业家的ADHD发病率可能比普通人更高（Nicolaou et al.，2011）。捷蓝航空的创始人理查·尼尔曼（Richard Neeleman）非常欣赏他的ADHD带来的优势：“如果有人告诉我你可以选择变成正常人或者继续保有ADD（ADHD最初的名字），我会选择ADD。”尼尔曼告诉ADDitude杂志[3]，“我可以分析复杂的事实，并想出简单的解决方案。我能够看着一个充满问题的行业说：‘我怎样可以做得更好？’我的ADD大脑能自然而然地去寻找更好的做事方法。”
p161.en: In fact, Albert Einstein, Leonardo da Vinci, Bill Clinton and Walt Disney are thought to have ADHD symptoms. The incidence of ADHD among entrepreneurs may be higher than among ordinary people (Nicolau et al., 2011). Richard Neeleman, the founder of Jell-Land, greatly appreciates the advantages of his ADHD: “If someone tells me you can choose to become normal or keep the ADD, I will choose the ADD. "Nilman told ADDitude magazine[3], "I can analyze complex facts and come up with simple solutions. I can look at a problematic industry and say, "How can I do better?" 'My ADD brain can naturally look for better ways to do things.

p162.original: 精神科医生戴尔·阿什（Archer，2014，2015）甚至认为，ADHD是一种超能力，如果利用得当，它可以推动个体成就伟业。值得注意的是，他断言：“ADHD特质中的一些最常见特质——创造力、多任务处理、冒险、精力充沛甚至韧性——事实上，如果以正确的方式和在正确的职业中加以利用，就会成为优势。”因此，与其压抑ADHD的症状，也许把它导向产出的方向，利用它们并把它们转化为积极因素，可能是一种更好的解决之道。它不仅不是一种令人沮丧的疾病，反而让人精力充沛并充满力量。这是值得思考的事情。
p162.en: The psychiatrist, Archer, 2014, 2015 even believes that ADHD is a superpower that, if properly used, can drive individual achievement. It is worth noting that he asserted that “some of the most common features of the ADHD quality — creativity, multi-task processing, risk taking, energy and even resilience — are in fact superior if used in the right way and in the right profession. Thus, rather than repressing the symptoms of ADHD, it might be a better solution to direct it towards output, to use them and to turn them into positive elements. It is not just a disheartening disease, but rather a dynamic and powerful one. That's something to think about.
